text.p: Bonds closed little changed in thin liquidity with the market recovering from its lows in line with Spain.
The Portuguese and the Spanish 10-year cash bonds remained firmly linked and the local market was expected to track the bonos closely again on Wednesday.
"We picked up significantly...following the Spanish recovery. But everything was done in low liquidity," said one trader.
Traders said that they noted some buying interest when the spread with Spain in the 10-year narrowed to zero at one point.
Support for the futures contract was put at 106.00, with resistance at 106.50.
